backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining user profiles, registrations, announcements, chat messages, and polls with access control, blob storage mixins, and CRUD operations for a community portal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features related to fixing YHash serialization errors by ensuring 32-byte hash values in ProfileSetupModal's ExternalBlob handling.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration with descriptions of their functionality and recent changes to ProfileSetupModal for hash generation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode CSS variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, 'Gram Sansad' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component managing authentication flow, profile setup modal display, routing (chat, admin, register), announcement notifications, theme provider, and loading states.
frontend/src/components/AnnouncementComp: Form component for admins to compose and send announcements with textarea, character counter, validation, and toast notifications on success/failure.
frontend/src/components/ChatInterface.ts: Chat interface with scrollable message list, auto-scroll behavior, message polling, empty state, and integrated MessageComposer in a fixed-height container.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Renders individual chat messages supporting text, photo, and video content types with appropriate icons and media display in a card layout.
frontend/src/components/ImageUploadField: Reusable image upload component with file selection, preview, ExternalBlob conversion, upload progress tracking, and remove functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header, navigation (Community Chat, Announcements for admins, Registration), user profile display, logout functionality, and responsive mobile menu with social media links in footer.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Login screen component that displays the Gram Sansad branding and a button to authenticate users via Internet Identity.
Message input component that allows users to send text messages, upload photos/videos, and create polls with file handling and validation.
frontend/src/components/PollCreator.tsx: Dialog component for creating polls with a question and multiple options (minimum 2), with add/remove option functionality.
frontend/src/components/PollDisplay.tsx: Component that displays poll questions and options, allows voting, and shows results with vote counts and percentage progress bars after voting.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for initial profile creation that prompts new users to enter their name and creates a profile with placeholder data for later completion during registration.
frontend/src/components/RegistrationForm: React form component for user registration with validation for personal details (name, age, contact, location) and Aadhaar photo upload. Displays success state after submission and handles registration errors including duplicate registration detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating anonymous or authenticated actors based on Internet Identity state. Invalidates and refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnnouncementNotifi: Custom hook that monitors announcements and triggers browser notifications with audio alerts when new announcements are posted. Requests notification permissions on mount and tracks announcement count changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality with configurable AuthClient options. Manages authentication state, identity persistence, and exposes login status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend API operations including user profile management, registration, announcements, chat messages, polls, and admin functions. Each hook uses the actor from useActor and manages query/mutation state with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining color schemes for UI components including primary, secondary, accent, and semantic colors. Sets base typography styles for the application.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up the React root with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication. Renders the main App component with necessary context providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminAnnouncementsPag: Admin-only page for creating and viewing announcement history with role-based access control. Displays announcement composer, list of past announcements, and shows access denied alert for non-admin users.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page component that renders the ChatInterface component within a card layout with a header describing the community chat feature.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx: Registration page that displays the RegistrationForm component in a card layout with descriptive header and icon. Serves as the entry point for new user registration.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended theme properties including sidebar colors, border radius variables, custom animations, and typography/container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document for Gram Sansad community web app tracking implemented features (user registration with Aadhaar upload, announcements with push notifications, community chat with media and polls) and a known issue with YHash byte length during profile creation.
